summary.en: Local memory hub for multi-channel DSH characters: isolated per-source memory with snapshots and restore, Inbox/Outbox with per-client targets and offline merge, model-callable memory tools, optional payment intents, all local-only.
summary.zh: 多端 DSH 角色的本机记忆中枢：按来源隔离记忆与快照恢复，支持分端收件箱/发件箱与离线并回、模型可直接调用的记忆工具、可选支付意图，全部只在本机运行。

repoDescription: 多端 DSH 角色的本机记忆中枢：来源隔离、快照恢复、分端收发件箱、离线并回、模型工具、可选支付意图。Local memory hub for multi-channel DSH characters.

zh: 按角色和来源隔离记忆，来源之间互不影响；写入前自动快照，可删除单条或恢复到最近/指定快照
分端 Inbox/Outbox：按 target 投递，离线消息先存本地、上线再取；/cross 可一次写入并投递
/memory/flush 把离线来源并回正常来源，自动去重并清空离线来源
模型工具 memory_hub_*：安装者自己的模型可直接读写本机记忆，无需额外客户端
可选 payment 配置：金额档位、本地支付意图、带金额的支付地址，不处理支付凭证
默认只监听 127.0.0.1，数据落在安装者自己的 DSH_HOME；端数、角色数、来源数不设固定上限，容量上限可配 0 表示不限
默认无遥测、不主动联网、不收集安装者或用户数据；任何收集需显式同意
支持 enabled: false 或 disabled: true 停用，停用后不启动服务、不注册工具、不影响安装者模型
模型适配：自动探测本机 Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM 等 OpenAI 兼容服务，也可手动登记任意模型端口，不绑定 DeepSeek
en: Per-character and per-source isolated memory with automatic snapshots, single-record delete and snapshot restore
Per-client Inbox/Outbox with targets and offline queueing; /cross writes and delivers in one call
/memory/flush merges an offline source back, dedupes and clears it
memory_hub_* tools let the installer's own model read/write local memory
Optional payment config: presets, local payment intents and checkout URL; no payment credentials
Listens on 127.0.0.1 by default, data under the installer's DSH_HOME; no fixed cap on clients/characters/sources, limits accept 0 for unlimited
No telemetry, no outbound collection, no installer/user data collection without explicit consent
Disable with enabled: false or disabled: true; no server, tools or model impact
Model adapters: auto-detect local Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, or register any model port; not tied to DeepSeek
